statement.name: dummy
statement.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R],
  IsDomain R →
    (∀ (a b : R), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → ∃ d r s, d = r * a + s * b ∧ ∀ (t : R), t ∣ a → t ∣ b → t ∣ d) →
      (∀ (a : ℕ → R), (∀ (n : ℕ), a (n + 1) ∣ a n) → ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, IsUnit (a n)) → IsPrincipalIdealRing R

comparison.candUnfolded:
∀ {R : Type u_0} [inst : CommRing R],
  IsDomain R →
    (∀ (a b : R), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → ∃ d r s, d = r * a + s * b ∧ ∀ (t : R), t ∣ a → t ∣ b → t ∣ d) →
      (∀ (a : ℕ → R), (∀ (n : ℕ), a (n + 1) ∣ a n) → ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, IsUnit (a n)) → IsPrincipalIdealRing R
comparison.refUnfolded:
∀ {R : Type u_0} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : GCDMonoid R],
  (∀ (a b : R), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → ∃ r s, gcd a b = r * a + s * b) →
    (∀ (a : ℕ → R), (∀ (i : ℕ), a i ≠ 0 ∧ a (i + 1) ∣ a i) → ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∃ u, IsUnit u ∧ a n = u * a N) →
      IsPrincipalIdealRing R
